shipped_rows.title_o: Sex differences in the allocation of pay.

blind_target.authors: Major, B., McFarlin, D., Gagnon, D.
blind_target.title: Overworked and underpaid.
blind_target.evidence_quote: Previous research has suggested that women pay themselves significantly less than men pay themselves for the same amount of work (Callahan-Levy & Messé, 1979; Major, McFarlin, & Gagnon, 1984). In an experimental study involving 132 participants (68 men and 64 women), this “depressed-entitlement effect” was replicated in a current sample of university students.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Previous research has suggested that women pay themselves significantly less than men pay themselves for the same amount of work (Callahan-Levy & Messé, 1979; Major, McFarlin, & Gagnon, 1984). In an experimental study involving 132 participants (68 men and 64 women), this “depressed-entitlement effect” was replicated in a current sample of university students.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract attributes the effect to both studies and states that this effect was replicated in the new sample.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract says the current experiment replicated the depressed-entitlement effect and cites Major, McFarlin, and Gagnon (1984) as one source for the exact pay-allocation finding. The sole supplied shipped row is the distinct Callahan-Levy and Messé (1979) original, so Major et al. is not represented among checked rows.
